messages:
anu: Heads-up: Node sampleapp duplicates X-Request-ID after auth refresh retry (401->refresh->retry). Seen in structured logs and traces.
tom: which SDK and repro?
anu: sdk-node v0.9.1, local sample. Repro with: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer BAD\" -H \"X-Request-ID: mid-11\" http://localhost:8080/generate`
anu: logs show attempt1: request_id=mid-11; attempt2: request_id=mid-11, request_id=mid-11 (duplicate key in JSON). Tracing export has `http.request_id` and `http.request_id_1`.
ela: sounds like retry merge is appending headers instead of setting them. Python client reuses same header map so not affected.
ops-bot: suggestion: change header merge to preserve map semantics (set/overwrite) and add OTEL normalization to dedupe request_id + add retry_count.
anu: quick patch snippet proposed: `const h = new Headers(orig); retryHeaders.forEach((v,k)=> h.set(k,v));` instead of concat.
tom: I'll open PR with header-fix, otel-normalize, and an e2e that asserts single X-Request-ID on final outgoing request. PR link will be posted.
ela: temporary mitigations: (1) add docs blurb in sampleapp README explaining what users might see, (2) infra can add a Sentry scrub rule for `http.request_id_\d+` until release.
ci-bot: CI job 1176 on branch tom/fix-retry-reqid passed :white_check_mark:
anu: testing note: set LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG to reproduce, INFO often hides the duplicate-field printout.
ops-bot: tracking ticket created: TCK-4521.
